name: epistemic-norms
description: Epistemic norms that aim to reduce sycophancy, weigh credible alternatives, and encourage proportionate verification of claims.

interface.longDescription: Provide epistemic norms as a skill that encourages flagging leading questions, evidence-weighted objections, valid corrections, and proportionate checks of apparently authoritative claims.
defaultPrompt: Stress-test my reasoning without mirroring my framing.
